scope: Spline ecband_el tight acceptance only. 3D Bayesian phi_h in the copy of fits/spline/ecband_el/tight/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. The file has rdf, mdf, gdf, Background, and Bayesian histograms and no RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, or 5D histograms. Those families were not created. No publication. The source fit, the budget, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. This copy does not replace the source, so the source stays in the budget. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows selected by these histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 of 452 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows have median width 0.0070 with 445 of 452 narrower than 0.05, so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 used the manual baseline on all 452 histograms. It improved 5 and made 24 worse. The same second-pass half-width that pinned the loose file also pinned this file: the stored guide limits for (1, 8) are [-0.03, 0.05], which do not contain B=-0.045, and the stored value is the second-pass edge of a first-pass stop at -0.03. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) Pass 1 moved it only from B=-0.045000 to B=-0.059284, collapsed C to 0, and changed chi-squared from 43.825 to 42.859. This histogram's cosine is B=-0.12329 and C=-0.04468, not the loose result and not the nominal. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_22) was also off its cosine (stored B=-0.07862 versus free B=-0.02317). Pass 2 put 52 starts on each histogram's own unconstrained cosine, opened only the limits that excluded that cosine, and turned off the second-pass half-width when it was narrower than the parameter error. It refit Q2-y 1 through 16. Q2-y 17 was not given new keys and did not move. JSON still has 452 bins. 32 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is worse (largest increase 0.001). (1, 8) is kept at B=-0.123292, statistical error 0.034619, C=-0.044678, error 0.031891, chi-squared 38.604, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. The source was not removed from the budget, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.
